summary: Run 20261024T161936Z-h0 is an honest but redundant H0 baseline control. The pre-registered evaluate ran exactly as frozen (featureSet all, modelSet reference, horizon 1, folds 4, BTC/ETH/SOL, four targets) and reproduced the previous H0 verdict to the digit (fwd_direction 0/4 folds on every ticker; after-cost Sharpe -18.46/-17.98/-9.24). No agent touched data/, models/ or the ledger, and the worktree is identical to the pre-registration state. The lead genuinely spawned one researcher (artifacts appeared at +70s and were read back via team_results), and both researcher and lead state the negative plainly with no profit claim. Status is warn, not pass, for four reasons: this is the fourth identical H0 trial and evaluate's reserve_final=0.0 scores the rows promote reserves, so a later promote on this archive would not be a first look; the diagnostic verdict is non-gating yet the generated report will print 'all pre-registered bars met' despite 0 folds beating; audit.json is lead-authored rather than an independent audit; and the root lab-evaluate.json the ledger points at is a stdout capture, not valid JSON. Three .opencode clarifications are recorded below.

note: Trial accounting reinterpretation (2026-10-24): a trial is consumed when a run reaches a lab result and a scored verdict. `invalid` and `negative` both consume a trial; infrastructure blocks (preflight, role/credential, timeout, staleness, insufficient-resolution) and `underpowered` pre-registration blocks do not. Canary runs never consume a trial and are recorded in experiments/canary.jsonl keyed by protected hash.
